text: Welcome to Mageborne! Below is a little preface to the story (Beta Version)
Hello, {name}. You have been hired by the townspeople of Emberpine to investigate
the nearby woods, after large monster tracks were found.
The game starts with you at the entrance of the woods, where you'll walk through
and face different types of monsters.
intro.continue_prompt: Press Enter to enter the woods

woods.text: You enter the woods, what would you like to do?

check.label: perception
check.fail_text: You don't notice any evidence of monsters — searching again...

text: You find some torn fabric on the branches, leading towards a clearing.
Inside, stands 3 small goblins. Prepare for combat!
goblins_clues.continue_prompt: Press Enter to continue to Chapter 2

text: You follow the trail and eventually find a log laying across it.
A further look reveals it was deliberately placed there.
As you look around, you notice a smaller path leading to a clearing.
Inside, stands 3 small goblins. Prepare for combat!
goblins_trail.continue_prompt: Press Enter to continue to Chapter 2

text: You make some noise and lay out aromatic food around you, hoping to attract a monster.
After a few minutes, you hear hushed voices leading towards a clearing.
Inside, stands 3 small goblins. Prepare for combat!
goblins_bait.continue_prompt: Press Enter to continue to Chapter 2

chapter2.text: What would you like to do?

text: You examine the footprints left by the goblins — clearly not the culprits.
As you wonder who else could be responsible, you hear giggling up ahead.
Following the sound, you come upon a clearing with 2 fairies inside. Prepare for combat!
fairies_footprints.continue_prompt: Press Enter to continue to Chapter 3

text: As you look around, you notice shimmering magical dust on the branches.
Following the trail, you come upon a clearing with 2 fairies inside. Prepare for combat!
fairies_dust.continue_prompt: Press Enter to continue to Chapter 3

chapter3.text: What would you like to do?

text: You examine the footprints left by the fairies — not the culprits either.
As you wonder who is truly responsible, you hear loud growling up ahead.
Following the noise, you come upon a clearing with a large Troll inside. Prepare for combat!
troll_footprints.fight_prompt: Press Enter to start boss combat

text: You notice a large piece of fabric strung on the branches, along with smoke rising ahead.
Following the smoke, you come upon a clearing with a large Troll inside. Prepare for combat!
troll_fabric.fight_prompt: Press Enter to start boss combat

text: Once the Troll has been defeated, it's evident it was the culprit behind those monster tracks.
You head back to town to receive your payment and deliver the good news,
tired but victorious from your day of monster fighting.
Congratulations! You've successfully completed Mageborne: Beta Test Release!
The full Godot version will be released soon, and the full base game afterwards.
